name: Sculpt Spells
says: When casting an evocation spell that affects creatures you can see, choose 1 + spell level of them: they auto-succeed on the save and take no damage if they would take half on a success.
does: The cast sheet offers a picker for an evocation spell; sculptedOf checks the feature, the evocation school, at most 1 + slot level (cantrip 1), only creatures the spell reaches and the caster sees, not the caster, no repeats; sculptedSave gives a no-roll success, no condition, and no damage unless the spell's success outcome is 'other' (full damage kept).
seen: Cast sheet sculpt picker; the log and the save rows show the creature as spared (sculpted).
